chapter.verse: Tua lai takin Zeisu in thugentehna tawh thu a hilh-inah, “Mi khat in lo lai-ah leenggah kungte suan a, gawlin uum a, leenggah cil nading to a, tausang buk khat a lam khit ciangin, lo khote khawhlawhsakin gamdangah a pai hi.
Anlak hun a tun’ ciangin lo khawhlawhte’ khut tung panin a gah ngah dingin lo neipa in nasempa khat a sawl hi.
Tua lo khawhlawhte in a nasempa man uh a, a sat khit uh ciangin khut guak tawh a ciahsak uh hi.
Khatvei nasem a dang khat sawl kik a, tua pa’ lutang a liamsak khit uh ciangin a zahhuaisak uh hi.
Nasem adang khat a sawl kik ciangin amau in tua pa a that uh hi. Nasem dang tampi sawl a, kimkhat satin kimkhat a that uh hi.
Lo neipa in a it mahmah tapa sawltak khat bek a neih, ‘Tua mite in ka tapa a zahtak ding uh hi,’ ci-in a nunung penin a sawl hi.
Ahih hangin lo khawhlawhte in, ‘Hihpa in a inn luah dingpa ahi hi. Hong pai un, a luah nading teng i ngah theih nadingin amah that ni,’ ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Lo neipa’ tapa a mat khit uh ciangin, that uh a, leenggah lo nawl ah a paaikhia uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin lo neipa in bangci a bawl ding hiam? Amah hong pai-in, lo khawhlawhte sugawp a, leenggah lo midangte a cingsak hi.
Inn lamte’n a nilkhiat suang in, A nung ciangin innkiu suang a piang hi.
Tua thu Pasian in bawl a, Eite mai-ah a lamdang hi,” a cihna thu Lai Siangtho sungah a om note in khatvei beek sim ngeilo na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a gen hi.
Amaute in amah mat nading a zon’ uh hangin mihonpi a kihta uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amau a cihna a gen ahih lam a thei uh hi. Tua lai takin amah nusia-in a paikhia uh hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu’ kam tawh a mawhna man dingin Farisaite kimkhat leh Herod’ nungzuite kimkhat a kiangah a sawl uh hi.

Tuate in ama kiang a tun’ uh ciangin, “Sia aw, nang thutak genpa na hi hi. Kuamah na kihta kei a, mi maitang zahtak loin Pasian lam thu a tang takin na hilh cih ka thei uh hi. Kaisar kumpipa siah piak tuak ahi hiam, piak tuak lo ahi hiam?

Ka pia ding uh hiam, ka pia kei ding uh hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi. Zeisu in amaute’ simtatna a theih ciangin, “Bang hangin kei hong ze-et na hi uh hiam? Denarias peek khat ka et dingin hong paipih un,” a ci hi.
A hong paipih uh ciangin Zeisu in, “Hih in kua lim, kua min ahi hiam?” ci-a a dot ciangin, “Kaisar kumpipa’ lim leh min hi,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Kaisar kumpipa’ sum, Kaisar kumpipa na pia un. Pasian’ sum, Pasian na pia un,” a ci hi. Amaute in amah lamdang a sa uh hi.
Misite’ thawhkikna om lo hi a ci Saddusi-te in, tua lai takin Zeisu kiangah va pai uh a,
“Topa aw, ‘Mi khat in a sih ciangin a zi nusia-in, ta a neih kei leh, a nau in a zi luah hen la, a u’ khang a man’ loh nadingin kizom ta hen,’ ci-in Moses in kote lai hong pia hi.
Unau sagih a om uh hi. A upa pen in zi nei a, ta nei loin a si hi.
A nau upa pen in a zi luah a, ta nei loin a si hi.
Tua bangin a thumna in a hih hi. Unau sagihte in ta nei lo uh hi. A nunung penin numei zong a si hi.
Thawhkik ni ciangin tua numei in tuate lakah kua pen’ zi ahi ding hiam? Bang hang hiam na cih leh, sagihte in tua numei tawh a kiteeng zo hi,” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in zong, “Note in Lai Siangtho ahi zongin, Pasian’ vangliatna ahi zongin thei lo na hih uh ciangin, um khial hilo na hi uh hiam?
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, sihna pan a thawhkik uh ciangin kipi-in a kiteengsak kei ding uh hi. Amaute in vantungmite tawh kibangin a om ding uh hi.
A sisate thawhkikna ding thu panin Pasian in, ‘Kei in Abraham Pasian, Isaak’ Pasian, Jakob’ Pasian ka hi hi,’ ci-in Moses in a gelh Lai Siangtho sunga sawlbawk meikuang thu sim ngeilo na hi uh hiam?
Pasian in a site’ Pasian hi loin a nungtate’ Pasian ahi hi. Nakpi-in na khial uh hi,” a ci hi.
Laitheipa khat hong pai a, thu kidongte Zeisu in kituak mahmahin a dawn’ kik a theih ciangin, “Thukham lianbel bang ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Zeisu in, “Thukham a lianpen in, ‘Israel mipawlte aw, ngai un: eite Topa Pasian in Topa khat bek ahi hi.
Na Topa Pasian na lungsim khempeuh, na kha khempeuh, na pilna khempeuh, na hatna khempeuh tawh na it in.
Thukham a nihna in, ‘Na pumpi na it bangin na lawmte na it in,’ ahi hi. Hih thukhamte sangin thukham lianzaw a om kei hi,” a ci hi.
Laitheipa in, “Topa aw, Pasian khat bek hi a, tua Pasian sim loh adang Pasian a om kei hi cih thu na gen in ahi takpi hi.
Tua Pasian lungsim khempeuh tawh it a, ama pumpi a it bangin a lawmte zong a it ding in, a pum mei a khul biakna leh sagawh biakna sangin a pha zaw hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua pa in pilna tawh a gen kik Zeisu in a theih ciangin, “Nang in Pasian Gam tawh na kigamla kei hi,” a ci hi. Tua nung ciangin mi khat beek in thu a dong ngam nawn kei uh hi.
Zeisu in biakna innpi sungah thu a hilh lai takin, “Khazih in David’ Ta ahi,’ ci-in laitheite in bangci a gen thei uh hiam?
David in: ‘Topa in, Na galte na khe nuai-ah ka koih matengin, Ka ziat lamah na tu in, ci-in ka Topa kiangah a ci hi,’ ci-in Kha Siangtho tawh a gen hi.
David in, ‘Khazih, Topa hi,’ ci ahih ciangin, bangci-in ama ta ahi thei ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Mihonte in nuam mahmahin a thu a ngai uh hi.
Zeisu in thu a hilh lai takin, “Laitheite na kikeem un. Amaute in puantual silhin a vak nuam uh hi.
Sumbuk ah zahtakna tawh hopihna, kikhopna inn sungah tokhom phabel, pawikhamna sungah tutna phabel a deih uh hi.
Amaute in meigongte’ neihsa a ne mang uh a, mawhna seel nadingin sau veipi thu a ngen uh hi. Tuate in mawhsakna lianzaw a thuak ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in sumkholna mai-ah tu a, mihonpite in dangka sumkholna sungah a khiat uh a en hi. Sumhau mi tampite in tampi a khia uh hi.
A zawng meigong khat hong pai a, dangkasan pai nih a khia hi.
Zeisu in a nungzuite sam a, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, sumkholna sungah a khia mi khempeuh lak panin tua a zawng meigong in tam a khia bel hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amaute in a sum val lak pan a khia uh hi. Tua numei ahih leh, a zawng napi-in ama kivak nading nangawn sit loin a khia zo hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
